decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted   therewith (Application Form, Design and Access Statement, Tree Survey, SRR-01 REV 2, Photo montage, Flood Risk Assessment, received 26/04/10SRR-02 REV 3 received 01/06/10.) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The basement shall not be converted to a separate dwelling.

Condition : 4 - No excavation, demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 7:30am to 5:00pm on Monday to Friday and 8:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Prior to any equipment, machinery or materials being brought onto the site, details of the measures to protect, the trees and other vegetation shown  to be retained on the approved plans, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Formation of a basement and lightwells to the front and side of the house.
